instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a shallow depth of field, captured in a medium close-up shot at eye-level. On an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing, backed by a dense forest of green trees, two women are embracing. On the right, the woman in the beige hoodie (R1) stands facing left, hugging the woman in the grey hijab (R3) on the left, who wears a pink jacket. The woman in the beige hoodie (R1) is laughing joyfully with her eyes closed, while the woman in the grey hijab (R3) smiles warmly. The affectionate embrace is captured in soft, natural daylight filtering through the trees, creating a sun-drenched and happy atmosphere.
